name: [bkms] 自动构建触发（[[ `[[ .appID ]]` ]]）
description: [请勿删除或修改] 蓝鲸服务治理（bkms）按应用下发的触发专用流水线，仅监听工蜂 Git 事件并回调 bkms，自身不执行构建

elements.name: 回调 bkms-server 触发构建
elements.script:
set -euo pipefail

# 回调地址与凭证引用由 TriggerPipelineManager.Ensure 二次渲染注入，勿在日志中打印 token
CALLBACK_URL="[[ `[[ .callbackURL ]]` ]]"
TOKEN="${{settings.[[ `[[ .credentialID ]]` ]].token}}"

if [ -z "${CALLBACK_URL}" ]; then
  echo "[ERROR] callback URL is empty"
  exit 1
fi
if [ -z "${TOKEN}" ]; then
  echo "[ERROR] callback token is empty"
  exit 1
fi

# policyID / event 来自命中触发器 additionalOptions.customVariables（触发器同步写入）；stepId 不承载业务含义
# event 缺省为 push，便于后续扩展其它触发事件
export POLICY_ID="${BKMS_TRIGGER_POLICY_ID:-}"
export EVENT="${BKMS_TRIGGER_EVENT:-push}"
export BRANCH="${BK_CI_REPO_GIT_WEBHOOK_BRANCH:-}"
export COMMIT_ID="${BK_CI_REPO_GIT_WEBHOOK_PUSH_HEAD_COMMIT_ID:-}"
export COMMIT_AUTHOR="${BK_CI_REPO_GIT_WEBHOOK_PUSH_USERNAME:-}"
export EVENT_TIME="${BK_CI_REPO_GIT_WEBHOOK_EVENT_TIME:-}"

# 一次编码整段 JSON，避免特殊字符破坏 body；空 eventTime 省略，避免 Go time.Time 解析空串失败
payload=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os

body = {
    "policyID": os.environ.get("POLICY_ID", ""),
    "event": os.environ.get("EVENT", "push"),
    "branch": os.environ.get("BRANCH", ""),
    "commitID": os.environ.get("COMMIT_ID", ""),
    "commitAuthor": os.environ.get("COMMIT_AUTHOR", ""),
}
event_time = os.environ.get("EVENT_TIME", "").strip()
if event_time:
    body["eventTime"] = event_time
print(json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False))
PY
)

echo "posting build-trigger callback (token redacted)"
echo "request body:"
echo "${payload}"
http_code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/bkms_bt_callback_resp.json -w "%{http_code}" \
  -X POST "${CALLBACK_URL}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Bkms-Build-Trigger-Token: ${TOKEN}" \
  -d "${payload}")

echo "callback HTTP status: ${http_code}"
cat /tmp/bkms_bt_callback_resp.json
echo

if [ "${http_code}" -lt 200 ] || [ "${http_code}" -ge 300 ]; then
  echo "[ERROR] callback failed with HTTP ${http_code}"
  exit 1
fi
